title: Elysium Automotive Core Ontology

sourcePolicy.notes: Conceptual automotive ontology. No OEM data. No copyrighted material.

disclaimer: Conceptual reference. Not a substitute for OEM documentation. Always verify location, pinouts, and exact specifications with authorized OEM service information.

nodes.name: Vehicle Make
nodes.description: Brand of the vehicle (e.g. Hyundai).

nodes.name: Vehicle Model
nodes.description: Model line within a make (e.g. Accent).

nodes.name: Year Range
nodes.description: Production year range for a model variant.

nodes.name: Engine
nodes.description: Engine family and displacement (e.g. 1.6L DOHC).

nodes.name: Transmission
nodes.description: Transmission type (manual, automatic, CVT).

nodes.name: Powertrain
nodes.description: Engine + transmission assembly.

nodes.name: Electrical System
nodes.description: 12V electrical subsystem: battery, alternator, wiring, fuses, relays.

nodes.name: Fuel System
nodes.description: Fuel delivery: pump, lines, filter, injectors, pressure regulator.

nodes.name: Ignition System
nodes.description: Spark generation: coils, plugs, timing, crank/cam sensors.

nodes.name: Cooling System
nodes.description: Coolant circulation: radiator, thermostat, water pump, fan, hoses.

nodes.name: Brake System
nodes.description: Service brakes: master cylinder, calipers, pads, rotors, ABS module.

nodes.name: Exhaust System
nodes.description: Exhaust gas path: manifold, catalytic converter, O2 sensors, muffler.

nodes.name: Powertrain Control Module
nodes.description: PCM/ECM — main computer controlling engine and drivetrain.

nodes.name: Fuel Pump
nodes.description: Electric pump that pressurizes fuel from tank to engine rail.

nodes.name: Fuel Pump Relay
nodes.description: Relay switching 12V to fuel pump. Coil driven by PCM, contact feeds pump.

nodes.name: Fuel Pump Fuse
nodes.description: High-current fuse in fuel pump feed circuit.

nodes.name: Battery
nodes.description: 12V lead-acid or AGM battery. Source of all 12V power.

nodes.name: Ground Point
nodes.description: Chassis/engine ground. Reference for all voltage measurements.

nodes.name: Spark Plug
nodes.description: Ignition spark source per cylinder.

nodes.name: O2 Sensor
nodes.description: Exhaust oxygen sensor. Inputs to fuel trim and catalyst monitor.

nodes.name: DTC
nodes.description: Diagnostic Trouble Code. Standardized OBD-II code identifying a detected condition.

nodes.name: PID
nodes.description: Parameter ID. Live data value readable via OBD-II Service $01.

nodes.name: Freeze Frame
nodes.description: Snapshot of PIDs at the moment a DTC was set.

nodes.name: Symptom
nodes.description: Observable customer/driver-reported condition.

nodes.name: Failure Mode
nodes.description: Specific way a component can fail (open, short, leak, etc).

nodes.name: Diagnostic Test
nodes.description: Specific test to confirm or rule out a cause.

nodes.name: Tool
nodes.description: Physical tool or measurement device required for a test.

nodes.name: Repair Procedure
nodes.description: Step-by-step procedure to repair a component.

nodes.name: Safety Warning
nodes.description: Mandatory safety precaution.

nodes.name: Risk
nodes.description: Quantified risk of continuing to drive or perform a procedure.

nodes.name: Legal Disclaimer
nodes.description: Mandatory legal notice for content.

validationRules.rule: edge.from and edge.to must reference existing node ids
